fields.q: 年纪越大，要发的牢骚就越多。或许我该改改了。
fields.en: The older I get, the more I find to grumble about. Perhaps I should work on that.
fields.name: 巴卡尼亚

q.value: 年纪越大，要发的牢骚就越多。或许我该改改了。

en.value: The older I get, the more I find to grumble about. Perhaps I should work on that.

fields.q: 你真有韧劲。你要是人的话，我真想把你训练成骑士。
fields.en: You're tenacious. If you were human, I'd want to train you as a knight.
fields.name: 巴卡尼亚

q.value: 你真有韧劲。你要是人的话，我真想把你训练成骑士。

en.value: You're tenacious. If you were human, I'd want to train you as a knight.

fields.q: 我这个年纪的人大都谈过恋爱，我却只对主君尽忠。不过这样也好，对吧？
fields.en: Most my age have had romantic relationships, I've only had loyalty to my lord. But that's fine, right?
fields.name: 巴卡尼亚

q.value: 我这个年纪的人大都谈过恋爱，我却只对主君尽忠。不过这样也好，对吧？

en.value: Most my age have had romantic relationships, I've only had loyalty to my lord. But that's fine, right?

fields.q: 住在基多尼亚时，我教年轻人武艺。要我教你几招吗？
fields.en: When I lived in Cydonia, I tutored youths in combat. Would you like me to teach you some martial arts?
fields.name: 巴卡尼亚

q.value: 住在基多尼亚时，我教年轻人武艺。要我教你几招吗？

en.value: When I lived in Cydonia, I tutored youths in combat. Would you like me to teach you some martial arts?

fields.q: 大小姐的心被复仇的念头占满了。要怎样才能让她解脱……
fields.en: Milady's heart is consumed with a desire for revenge. What I would do to free her from it…
fields.name: 巴卡尼亚

q.value: 大小姐的心被复仇的念头占满了。要怎样才能让她解脱……

en.value: Milady's heart is consumed with a desire for revenge. What I would do to free her from it…

fields.q: 为主君效力留下的伤疤都是勋章。我这道很帅气吧？
fields.en: Any scar you get in your lord's service is a badge of honor. Mine is handsome, don't you think?
fields.name: 巴卡尼亚

q.value: 为主君效力留下的伤疤都是勋章。我这道很帅气吧？

en.value: Any scar you get in your lord's service is a badge of honor. Mine is handsome, don't you think?

fields.q: 眼神这么坚定的鸟真少见。
fields.en: It's strange to see a bird with such conviction in its eyes.
fields.name: 巴卡尼亚

q.value: 眼神这么坚定的鸟真少见。

en.value: It's strange to see a bird with such conviction in its eyes.

fields.q: 假如敌人来袭，你要保护的人就在你身后，你会怎么做？
fields.en: Let's say an enemy attacked while your charge stood behind you. What would you do?
fields.name: 巴卡尼亚

q.value: 假如敌人来袭，你要保护的人就在你身后，你会怎么做？

en.value: Let's say an enemy attacked while your charge stood behind you. What would you do?

fields.q: 躲藏的那段日子，饭都是我做的。要我给你做点什么吗？
fields.en: When we were in hiding, I did all the cooking. Would you like me to make you something?
fields.name: 巴卡尼亚
